title: Vanilla Backpack
description: Vanilla+ Backpack adds a lightweight, upgradeable storage system to Minecraft 1.21.8. Start with a 18-slot leather backpack, and upgrade it to Golden (27 slots) and Diamond (52 slots) backpacks! Features custom advancements and crafting recipes!
body:
Vanilla Backpack is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly mod that solves early-game inventory issues without breaking the game.

Features:

✅ 18-slot Leather Backpack – Perfect for early mining and exploring.

✅ Golden Backpack (27 slots) – Upgrade your storage with a unique crafting recipe using a gold as the base.

✅ Diamond Backpack (52 slots) – The endgame storage solution. Craft it using diamond dust and diamond straps.

✅ Custom Advancements – Earn achievements for every upgrade.

✅ Vanilla Style – All textures and recipes fit perfectly into the vanilla aesthetic.

Enjoy new space in your inventory!
